# SQL API

`POST /api/sql` (**superusers**)

Runs one SQL statement on the app's main database and answers its result. Reads answer at most 1,000 rows.

| Body | |
|---|---|
| `query` | the statement |

```bash
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/sql -H "Authorization: $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query": "SELECT author, COUNT(*) AS posts FROM posts GROUP BY author"}'
```

```json
{
  "execTime": 1,
  "affectedRows": 0,
  "columns": [
    { "name": "author", "type": "TEXT", "nullable": true },
    { "name": "posts", "type": "", "nullable": true }
  ],
  "rows": [["0slkeutr0bxpw3v", "1"]]
}
```

`type` is the column's declared type, empty for an expression like `COUNT(*)`; values come back as SQLite gives
them, so an expression's number may arrive as a string.

It runs as written, past rules and hooks, so a write here skips validation: use it for reading and repairs, and the
[Records API](https://pocketone.dev/docs/rest/records) for normal writes.
